key_provisions.requirement: Every employer must pay wages not less than the applicable minimum wage. Floor wage set by Central Government applies nationally.
policy_checklist: HR policy must reference current applicable minimum wage
Must specify review frequency for wage revisions

key_provisions.requirement: Wages must be paid: daily workers on daily basis, weekly workers on weekly basis, monthly workers by 7th of following month. Bank transfer mandatory for establishments with 10+ workers.
policy_checklist: Policy must specify wage payment date
Must mandate bank transfer for eligible establishments
Must not specify payment later than 7th of month

key_provisions.requirement: No employer shall pay less remuneration to employees of one gender than employees of another gender for same work or work of similar nature.
policy_checklist: HR policy must contain explicit equal pay clause
Must define work of similar nature
Must specify grievance mechanism for pay discrimination

key_provisions.requirement: Overtime wages shall be at twice the normal rate of wages for every hour of overtime worked.
policy_checklist: Policy must specify overtime rate as 2x normal rate

key_provisions.requirement: Deductions from wages permitted only as specified: fines, absence, damage, advances, accommodation, amenities. Total deductions must not exceed 50% of wages.
policy_checklist: Policy must list permissible deductions only
Must specify 50% cap on total deductions
